summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine PDMR (director/manager) share transactions under its all-employee share purchase plan. Multiple executives, including the CFO and CHRO, acquired small numbers of ordinary shares at GBP 11.387677 per share on the London Stock Exchange. There are no strategic acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a routine notification of insider trading activity with no impact on corporate structure or control.
